content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a double free of memory pages when the `do_kexec_load()` function encountered a failure during memory allocation. Specifically, both `init_transition_pgtable()` and `machine_kexec_cleanup()` were calling `free_transition_pgtable()`, leading to an attempt to free the same memory pages multiple times. This resulted in crashes reported by syzbot due to the improper handling of memory deallocation in error scenarios. The patch resolves this by ensuring that the error handling is centralized in `machine_kexec_cleanup()` and by setting pointers to NULL after freeing the pages to prevent further attempts to free the same memory.
